Global sensitivity analysis of an APSIM output

Source: R/sensitivity.R
apsim_sensitivity.Rd

Quantifies how the parm_paths parameters drive a single scalar APSIM output over the box [lower, upper]. Morris screening (default) ranks the factors by mean absolute elementary effect (mu_star) and flags interaction / non-linearity (sigma) cheaply; the Sobol-Jansen method decomposes the output variance into first-order (S) and total (T) indices at a higher run cost. The two stages use the sensitivity package over the same forward model as the other verbs.

Usage

apsim_sensitivity(
  sim,
  parm_paths,
  lower,
  upper,
  output,
  target = NULL,
  method = c("morris", "sobol", "both"),
  morris_r = 10L,
  morris_levels = 6L,
  sobol_n = 100L,
  nboot = 100L,
  report = NULL,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

sim

An apsim_sim object or a path to an .apsimx file.

parm_paths

Character vector of APSIM node paths (the factors).

lower, upper

Numeric box bounds aligned to parm_paths (recycled from length one).

output

A function(report) -> named numeric or report column name(s) identifying the output (see apsim_forward_model()).

target

Character naming the single output column to analyse when output yields several; defaults to the first.

method

Character: "morris" (default), "sobol", or "both".

morris_r

Integer number of Morris elementary-effect repetitions.

morris_levels

Integer Morris grid levels.

sobol_n

Integer base sample size for Sobol (total runs n * (p + 2)).

nboot

Integer bootstrap replicates for Sobol confidence intervals.

report

Character report-table name, or NULL for the first report.

seed

Optional integer RNG seed.

Value

An apsim_manifest with inferential_target = "sensitivity" whose params holds one row per factor with the requested indices, or an apsim_abstention() when the simulator is unavailable.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # apsimR::apsim_available()
# Sensitivity analysis runs the simulator r(p + 1) times, so the example is
# wrapped in \dontrun{}; see the package vignette for a runnable walk-through.
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
f <- apsim_example("Wheat")
if (!is.na(f)) {
  apsim_sensitivity(
    f, parm_paths = "[Fertilise at sowing].Script.Amount",
    lower = 0, upper = 250, output = "Yield", method = "morris",
    morris_r = 4L, seed = 1L)
}
} # }
}
